name: Private agent run logs
whenToUse: Collect or inspect auditable execution data for authorized Lookout tasks; no grading.
instructions:
Use the scoped audit tools only when run logging is requested or part of an authorized task. Start with start_agent_audit_run using a stable eventKey, explicit live/controlled mode, task and area. Metadata should preserve actual model/settings, runtime, prompt/guide versions, code commit, experiment/task/fixture IDs and context snapshot references where available. Unknown values stay unknown. Keep candidate snapshots private. Logging never grants execution, consent, approval, sending or submission authority.

Append messages, tool calls/results, brief decision summaries, sources and observed timestamps, state snapshots, artifacts, failures/retries, user interventions, model usage and final outcomes as available. Use append_agent_audit_events, stable unique event keys and shared correlation IDs in data (for example toolCallId, parentEventKey, applicationId, backendJobId). Save promptly; batch at most 25 events within the 200 KB request and 128 KB/event-data bounds. Preserve oversized redacted evidence in separate chunks with artifactId, chunkIndex and totalChunks; record any truncation, missing capture or failed logging explicitly. Do not store hidden chain-of-thought. Never log this audit tool's own calls recursively.

Redact credentials, authorization headers, signed URLs and secrets before writing. The server rejects common secret patterns but cannot guarantee arbitrary free text is safe. Store durable private artifact IDs/paths and hashes, not expiring signed links. A user asking to collect data is not permission to send outreach or submit real applications.

Use run.finished/run.failed/run.interrupted events with observed outcomes, stop reason and available usage; never fabricate completion for a crashed run. These append-only logs are agent observations, not independent proof of external success or a second application state store. Runtime-native traces and actual backend receipts should be linked when available; manual event logging cannot capture information the runtime does not expose. No scores, judge or benchmark execution is added by these tools.

Read back with read_agent_audit_run. Continue afterSequence=nextSequence while hasMore; preserve server ingestion sequence separately from client occurredAt. Exact duplicate writes replay, changed retry data conflicts, and a failed batch commits nothing. Reconcile uncertain writes before retrying. Owners can inspect the same records in Supabase; workspace reset or account deletion removes their logs. Tables alone do not capture Muse activity automatically. Gateway/MCP release and agent tool discovery refresh are required before these tools are usable.
